entities.summary: Joel Glazer is an American businessman and sports team owner. He is part of the Glazer family, who control First Allied Corporation and HRG Group, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL), and Manchester United of the Premier League. The family is based in Florida.
